microbenchmark.type: Q8_0 weights, F32 input and output
microbenchmark.graphs: disabled to isolate dispatch plus kernel

control: stock RDNA3/RDNA4 Q8_0 ncols=1 MMVQ geometry: 8 wavefronts
intervention: Q8_0 ncols=1 MMVQ geometry: 4 wavefronts on RDNA3/RDNA4 only
numerical_gate: GPU output agrees with CPU Q8_0 graph at max_abs_error <= 1e-3 and max_rel_error <= 1e-3
correctness_gate: exact hyp_text and token_ids_csv match the graph-enabled control on jfk.wav, dots.wav, and noise.wav
minimum_useful_effect: weighted microbenchmark >=5% on one target, no target regression >2%, and served mean >=5% on one target with same-direction p95
kill_condition: numerical/correctness mismatch, no >=5% served win, or >2% served regression on either target
resource_gate: no additional persistent allocation; isolated physical GPU; graph-enabled served validation
evidence_class_goal: C then R across the second target
